title: Onslaught — Critics Say Adam Wingard's Latest is a Mixed Bag of Action and Horror
excerpt: The film receives mixed reviews, with some praising its nostalgic elements while others criticize its execution.
body:
• Adria Arjona's performance is a highlight of the film.
  • The film's nostalgic elements resonate with some viewers.
  • Weak writing and predictability are significant drawbacks.

Onslaught has garnered mixed reviews, with critics divided on its nostalgic homage to 1980s B-movies and its overall execution. Directed by Adam Wingard, this action-horror film follows an Army sniper, played by Adria Arjona, who must protect her daughter from genetically engineered super soldiers. The film attempts to blend horror and action but struggles to find a cohesive narrative.

What Critics Are Saying

"A gory tribute to B-movies from the 1980s tries and fails to say something about forever wars." — The New York Times
"Onslaught is a messy action spectacle weighed down by weak writing, uneven thrills, and an anticlimactic finish." — High on Films
"There's a committed performance from a spunky Adria Arjona, but the film is missing some sharper weaponry." — The Guardian
"The empty-headed siege pic might've made more sense if it was the late 1980s, but it feels quaint in today's context." — Roger Ebert
"Onslaught is a gnarly but familiar grab bag of action and horror tropes that fails to deliver a fresh experience." — Variety

"Onslaught has garnered mixed reviews, with critics divided on its nostalgic homage to 1980s B-movies and its overall execution."

https://x.com/DiscussingFilm/status/2095368944186270019

What Works

  • Performance: Adria Arjona's performance is highlighted as a strong point, showcasing her ability to carry the film's emotional weight amidst the chaos.
  • Nostalgic Elements: The film's homage to 1980s action and horror films resonates with some viewers, providing a sense of familiarity and fun.

What Doesn't

  • Poor Writing: Critics noted that the film suffers from weak writing and a lack of coherent plot, which detracts from the overall experience.
  • Predictable Tropes: Many reviews pointed out that the film relies heavily on familiar tropes, making it feel derivative and lacking originality.

The Verdict

While Onslaught offers some entertaining moments and a strong performance from Adria Arjona, its shortcomings in writing and predictability may leave audiences wanting more. For those who enjoy nostalgic action-horror films, it might still be worth a watch, but expectations should be tempered.
